title: French police raid Arab World Institute over ex-minister’s Epstein ties
summary: French police ​on Monday searched the Arab World Institute in Paris in connection with an investigation into its ​former ‌head, ex culture ⁠minister Jack Lang, and his ties with the convicted ‌sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. Lang resigned earlier this month from ​the organisation which he ​had led since 2013. FRANCE 24's James André reports.
